import numpy as np
def equation(t,P,params):
    w=0.41
    s=np.sin(w*t); c=np.cos(w*t)
    p=params
    poly = p[0]+p[1]*t+p[2]*t**2 + (p[3]+p[4]*t+p[5]*t**2)*P + (p[6]+p[7]*t+p[8]*t**2)*P**2 + (p[9])*P**3
    return poly + 0.0*s
